'''Jake Meiser''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[April 2000 Cincinnati tournament]] on 22 April 2000, according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d574">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-22-cincinatti-ohio-4-22-00d574/ cincinatti-ohio-4-22-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 22 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-22-cincinatti-ohio-4-22-00d574/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
